subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language ‘EARNED’ is written as ‘94’, ‘GAINED’ is written as ‘80’, then how will ‘DOLLAR’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Sum of the position values of letters according to English alphabetic series is multiplied by (2).

So,

 
• ‘EARNED’ is written as ‘94’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/462e02c5a53f420279e0623ca980aa46235caa38dd07d6fc9679ccfaaa2b0613.png] 

And,

 
• ‘GAINED’ is written as ‘80’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d71efb288228741827060a4cb9eef23711264700d4bee5a83c1822cb999bc2a3.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘DOLLAR’ is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0816b07fbfbc873851aa8ad5f602501a441f7055bf75f0082aef1b3fea1e2c21.png] 

​Hence, "124" is the correct answer.

91
